# Security reports

Please do not disclose vulnerabilities in public issues or pull requests.

Read the repository [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md) for supported versions, reporting instructions, and safe-disclosure expectations. If GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled, use the **Report a vulnerability** button on the repository Security tab.

Do not include live credentials, customer data, or production secrets in any report. If private reporting is unavailable, follow the fallback instructions in the root security policy.
